title: Cloud Engineer
description: Results-driven DevOps Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and automation solutions. Skilled in managing scalable, secure, and highly available environments on AWS and Azure. Proficient in tools like Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Ansible. Adept at bridging development and operations teams to accelerate release cycles, improve system reliability, and reduce downtime. Strong focus on monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.

title: Server Administrator Trainee
description: During the internship facilitated by the Tech Support division of IPSR, I gained practical experience in various aspects of system and cloud administration. I developed skills in server configuration for websites and web applications, along with server hardening and tuning to enhance performance and security. The internship also involved hands-on work with server monitoring, troubleshooting, and shell scripting, as well as proficiency in Git, mail servers, DNS, and FTP. Additionally, I acquired knowledge in hardware and networking fundamentals, including IP addressing and subnetting. A key component of the experience was working with AWS cloud computing, which broadened my understanding of scalable and flexible cloud solutions.
